{{Top|Lotus|Tenno|Tenno|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|For the Arbiters of Hexis these pistols are more than just simple weapons, they are symbols of truth and discipline.}} The '''Telos Akbolto''' is an exclusive version of the {{Weapon|Akbolto}} available only from the {{Faction|Arbiters of Hexis}}. Featuring significantly improved [[status chance]] at the expense of critical stats, the Telos Akbolto also possesses an innate [[Truth]] effect. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage. *On kill, bodies will follow the bolt that killed them, damaging anyone in their path and pinning the corpse to walls. *Innate [[Truth]] effect. *Innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} and {{Pol|Naramon}} polarities. {{Advantages| *Tied with {{Weapon|Akbolto}} for the fastest fire rate of all semi-auto pistols. *No initial spread. Spread increases very slightly on subsequent shots. }} {{Disadvantages| *Projectiles have travel time. }} {{WeaponComparison|Akbolto}} {{WeaponComparison|Akbolto Prime|header=n}} ==Acquisition== *The Telos Akbolto can be acquired by reaching the Rank of '''Maxim''' with the {{Faction|Arbiters of Hexis}}, and spending {{sc|100,000}} to purchase. As with all Syndicate Weapons, the Telos Akbolto cannot be chosen as the free offering upon ranking up to Maxim rank. *Syndicate weapons can be also be acquired via [[Trade System|Trading]], but only for unranked copies without [[Forma]] and [[Orokin Catalyst]] installed. *Players must have a [[Mastery Rank]] of at least 11 to acquire the Telos Akbolto, either through trading or through the Syndicates themselves. ==Tips== *Focused on {{D|Puncture}} damage, therefore effective against [[Corpus]] and [[Corrupted|Corrupted.]] *For effective use of non-hitscan weapons, it is strongly recommended to learn leading. In short, leading means aiming ahead of your target so the projectile hits them at their predicted location. *Moderate recoil makes fast subsequent shots more difficult to land when fire rate mods are used. *Using the {{M|Pistol Ammo Mutation}} mod can help regain lost ammo when needed. *With a decently leveled {{M|Magnum Force}} and fully leveled [[multishot]] mods such as {{M|Barrel Diffusion}} and {{M|Lethal Torrent}} these pistols visibly fire 2-3 bolts per shot. When used over a longer range this results in the Telos Akbolto having the effective use of "spray and pray" weapons whilst retaining respectable damage output and ammo economy. *The bolts spawn as physical objects at the muzzle of the Telos Akbolto. **If an enemy is standing right in front of you, so that the muzzle is '''inside''' of them, you will sometimes not be able to hit, because the Telos Akbolto is non-hitscan and pretty long, so the bolts spawn behind the hitbox of that enemy. **Also if taking cover behind a thick object (i.e. door case) you will not be able to shoot anything but the wall in front you if the muzzle is '''inside''' of that object. *The innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity is perfect for [[Galvanized Shot]] or modding [[Viral]] damage with [[Deep Freeze]]. ==Trivia== *The word ''telos'' means an ultimate end or goal, derived from Greek ''teleology'', essentially the study of purpose. *The Telos Akbolto was the first item to hold the "''Telos''" prefix. The [[Telos Syandana]] was second. ==Media== TelosAkboltoCodex.png|Telos Akbolto in Codex. {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|eyvFVUQotis|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|itf0s6WK398|size=300px}} }} {{clr}} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32.2}} ;SEMI-AUTOMATIC WEAPON CHANGES While reviewing the stats of some weapons with a semi-automatic mode, we noticed that certain weapons had an unsustainably high fire rate for most players. We adjusted the stats of the following semi-automatic weapons whose maximum potential was only being reached with the use of macros (to learn more about third-party use in Warframe visit our [https://digitalextremes.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360030014351-Third-Party-Software-and-You support article]). Since not everyone is an avid macro user (within the boundaries allowed), '''we lowered fire rates to a more humanly achievable level and improved their damage or reload stats to compensate.''' '''Telos Akbolto''' *Reduced fire rate from 10 to 5. *Increased damage from 47 to 70. *Reduced reload time from 2.6 to 2. {{ver|22.12}} *Mastery Rank increased from 6 to 11 *[[Status chance]] increased from 12.5% to 29% *[[Critical chance]] increased from 10 to 13% *Damage decreased from 50 to 47. {{ver|Specters of the Rail 2.2}} *Fixed enemies not being alerted by the Telos AkBolto. {{ver|17.4}} *Fixed missing weapon trails from projectiles created by the Telos Akbolto. {{ver|16.8.1}} *Ormolu Skin now works on the Telos Akbolto! {{ver|15.13}} *Fixed unique energy colors not applying to the Telos Akbolto. {{ver|15.5}} *Introduced. }}
''Last update: {{ver|22.15}}''

{{Top|Lotus|Tenno|Tenno|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Bring down judgement, with this Boltor crafted by the Arbiters of Hexis.}} The '''Telos Boltor''' is the {{Faction|Arbiters of Hexis}} variant of the {{Weapon|Boltor}}, featuring improved damage, critical stats, fire rate, and magazine size. The Telos Boltor also features an innate [[Truth]] effect. ==Characteristics== * This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage. * Bolts fired stick to their target, and will fling bodies on kill. **The body will damage targets in its path. **Corpses can be pinned to terrain. {{Advantages|*Innate [[Truth]] effect provides additional AoE damage, a health restore, and [[Maneuvers|parkour]] buff. *Flung bodies help in dealing with crowds. *Low recoil.}} {{Disadvantages|*Projectiles have travel time with slight arcing.}} {{WeaponComparison|Boltor}} {{WeaponComparison|Boltor Prime|header=n}} ==Acquisition== *The Telos Boltor can be acquired by reaching the Rank of '''Maxim''' with the {{Faction|Arbiters of Hexis}}, and spending {{sc|125,000}} to purchase. As with all Syndicate Weapons, the Telos Boltor cannot be chosen as the free offering upon ranking up to Maxim rank. *Syndicate weapons can also be acquired via [[Trade System|Trading]], but only for unranked copies without [[Forma]] and [[Orokin Catalyst]] installed. *Players must have a Mastery Rank of at least 12 to acquire the Telos Boltor, either through trading or through the Syndicates themselves. ==Incarnon Genesis== {{Transclude|Boltor Incarnon Genesis#Acquisition}} {{Transclude|Boltor Incarnon Genesis#Incarnon Genesis}} ==Trivia== *Tied with {{Weapon|Prisma Gorgon}}, {{Weapon|Soma}}/{{Weapon|Soma Prime}}, and {{Weapon|Tenora Prime}} for the second highest [[critical chance]] of all fully automatic rifles, behind {{Weapon|Battacor}} and {{Weapon|Acceltra}}. ==Media== HexisBoltorCodex.png|Telos Boltor in Codex. Telos Boltor (1).png|Telos Boltor when shown in the arsenal Telos Boltor (2).png| {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|X1DYF1EaTnE}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|28}} *Fixed the Boltor Bravura Skin being broken when equipped on the Telos Boltor. {{ver|22.17.1.1}} *Fixed unintended shell dropping sound on Telos Boltor. {{ver|22.12}} *Status Chance increased from 7.5% to 16% *[[Critical chance]] increased from 5% to 30% *Critical damage increased from 2x to 2.4x *Damage decreased from 50 to 30 {{ver|19.5}} *'''Conclave:''' **Reduced magazine size from 90 to 42. {{ver|17.4}} *Fixed missing weapon trails from projectiles created by the Telos Boltor. {{ver|17.3}} *Telos Boltor introduced. }}
''Last update: {{ver|22.17.1.1}}''

{{Top|Enemy|Corpus|Corpus|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Parvos Granum’s engineers have made this already ferocious hand-cannon even more deadly with the addition of an alternate fire mode that empties an entire clip in one devastating burst.}} The '''Tenet Detron''' is the [[Tenet]] variant of the {{Weapon|Detron}} pistol shotgun, featuring enhanced [[critical chance]], [[critical multiplier]], overall [[status chance]] due to increased [[multishot]] despite its base status being lowered, and [[accuracy]] that exceeds the {{Weapon|Mara Detron}}, along with a slight increase to magazine size, at the cost of a steep damage penalty. It has gained an [[Alternate Fire]] that burst-fires its entire magazine. ==Characteristics== *This weapon primarily deals {{D|Radiation}} damage. *[[Alternate Fire]] shoots all remaining ammunition in the magazine in a quick burst. **Benefits from magazine increasing mods to further increase the burst's damage. *Can use the {{Weapon|Detron}}-exclusive {{M|Thermagnetic Shells}} mod. *Adversary Weapon: **Comes with an additional bonus {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Cold}}, {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Magnetic}}, or {{D|Radiation}} damage, based on the Sister's [[Adversary System/Progenitor|progenitor Warframe]], which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%. ***[[Valence Fusion]] can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%). **[[Polarization|Polarizing]] the weapon increases its max [[rank]] by '''2''', capping at rank '''40''' after '''5''' polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity. **{{Resource|Elemental Vice}} can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely. **Listed [[Mastery Rank]] requirement is not enforced - the weapon may theoretically be obtained at any mastery rank by acquiring and vanquishing a Sister that has this weapon equipped. {{Advantages|class=Shotgun Sidearm| *Very high overall [[status chance]]. *Good [[accuracy]]. *Innate [[multishot]] of 10 pellets. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Shotgun Sidearm| *Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 55% from 26m to 52m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *Projectiles have travel time. }} {{WeaponComparison|Detron}} {{WeaponComparison|Mara Detron}} ==Acquisition== {{Transclude|Adversary System/Weapons#Tenet Acquisition (Sister)}} ==Notes== *The [[Alternate Fire]] of the Tenet Detron will eject all of the remaining ammunition in the magazine in a single burst. **Base effective fire rate is '''8''' rounds per second. ***The burst is affected by [[Fire Rate]] mods, but not perfectly; +60% Fire Rate only resulted in roughly +45% effect. **Increasing the magazine size of the weapon such as with {{M|Slip Magazine}} ({{M|Primed Slip Magazine|Primed}}) and {{M|Tainted Clip}}, and using recoil reduction mods like {{M|Steady Hands}}, can help to make its damage output more consistent and reliable. **If buffed with unlimited ammo such as from the [[Void Fissure#Reactant Buff|Reactant Buff]], the weapon will only fire a burst equal to its current magazine, with small delays between each trigger pull. **Alternate Fire can be canceled using quick melee. **Aiming will be disabled for the duration of the burst, and so the Alternate Fire cannot benefit from [[Acolyte Mods]]. *The ability to to unload all its magazine in one powerful burst is shared with the Grineer {{Weapon|Kuva Kraken}}, {{WF|Octavia}}'s {{Weapon|Pandero}} ({{Weapon|Pandero Prime|Prime}}), and the [[Amalgam]] {{Weapon|Cyanex}}. *Despite the lower base damage compared to its predecessors, the Tenet Detron's increased [[Multishot]] (10 pellets vs. 7 pellets) results in higher overall damage even with the lowest possible elemental bonus (+25%). **For example, a Tenet Detron with a +25% {{D|Toxin}} damage bonus gains 6.5 more damage for a total of 32.5 damage per pellet. With 10 pellets, that results in 325 damage per shot, compared to the 280 damage of the standard Detron or the Mara Detron. {{Transclude|Adversary System#Notes}} {{Transclude|Adversary System/Progenitor}} ==Tips== *In {{WF|Mag}}'s hands, the Tenet Detron is a potentially devastating weapon as she can pulverize crowds of enemies by unloading the gun's alt-fire burst into a short-tap {{A|Magnetize}} bubble. Combined with its very fast reload speed, Mag can unleash torrents of shot in the entire duration of the bubble, and with {{M|Thermagnetic Shells}} equipped, deadly explosions scaling against enemy health push the damage output further. **Combine this already devastating setup with a thrown melee weapon with {{M|Combo Fury}} to double the bubble's received torrent of shot per burst. ==Bugs== *The falloff ranges displayed ingame (13m-22m) are incorrect. Tenet Detron will still deal full damage until about 28m. *Projectiles created by modified multishot on Tenet Detron use the {{Weapon|Detron}} stats which results in significantly worse critical chance and critical damage, and slightly worse status chance. [[Condition Overload (Mechanic)]] effects continue to scale off of Tenet's 26 damage rather than Detron's 40, resulting in CO being only 65% effective. The alt-fire is unaffected by this issue and functions as expected. ==Media== {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|33}} *Changed the Synth Charge Mod to now apply to the following weapons: **Tenet Detron {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Secondary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 20 Ammo per Pick Up: *Tenet Detron {{ver|30.5}} *Introduced. }} ==See Also== *{{Weapon|Detron}}, the normal counterpart of this weapon. *{{Weapon|Mara Detron}}, another variant of this weapon. *{{Weapon|Kuva Brakk}}, the Kuva equivalent of this weapon. *{{Weapon|Kuva Kraken}}, a Kuva weapon with a similar alt-fire ability. *{{Weapon|Cyanex}}, an [[Amalgam]] weapon with a similar alt-fire ability. *{{Weapon|Pandero}} ({{Weapon|Pandero Prime|Prime}}), {{WF|Octavia}}'s signature weapon with a similar alt-fire ability. {{WeaponNav}} [[es:Detron tenet]] [[uk:Детрон-догмат]] [[Category:Tenet Weapons]] [[Category:Corpus Weapons]] [[Category:Radiation Damage]] [[Category:Radiation Damage Weapons]]

{{Top|Enemy|Corpus|Corpus|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|This reengineered Cycron features a refracting energy disc that can split off its main target hitting up to two additional nearby targets.}} The '''Tenet Cycron''' is the [[Tenet]] variant of the {{Weapon|Cycron}} beam pistol, with improved [[critical chance]], [[status chance]], and total damage. Its beam has also gained the ability to chain between multiple enemies. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals {{D|Heat}} damage. *Takes 0.6 seconds of firing to ramp up the damage from 30% to 100%. After firing stops for 0.8 seconds, the damage decays back to 30% over 2 seconds. *Innate 1 meter [[punch through]]. *Beam can chain up to '''2''' nearby enemies within '''7''' meters from the initial target, each doing '''60%''' of the main beam's damage. **Enemy corpses will still allow the beam to connect to nearby enemies. **If multiple enemies are hit with the main beam thanks to punch through, up to 2 chains are generated from each of them. An enemies can be hit by the main beam, and by one chain per other enemies hit by the main beam. *Does not use ammo pickups; ammo regenerates over time. **Has a '''0.5''' second delay after the weapon stops firing before regenerating ammo. Then, regenerates '''40''' ammo per second; takes '''1''' second to regenerate a fully depleted battery excluding the delay. This delay may be reduced/increased with {{M|Quickdraw}} ([[Primed Quickdraw|Primed]]), {{M|Stunning Speed}}, {{M|Tainted Clip}}. **Does not benefit from mods that increase [[Ammo#Ammo%20Maximum|maximum ammo]], due to lack of an ammo pool. **Does not benefit from reload-triggered mods such as {{M|Pressurized Magazine}}. *Innate two {{Pol|Naramon}} polarities. *Adversary Weapon: **Comes with an additional bonus {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Cold}}, {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Magnetic}}, or {{D|Radiation}} damage, based on the Sister's [[Adversary System/Progenitor|progenitor Warframe]], which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%. ***[[Valence Fusion]] can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%). **[[Polarization|Polarizing]] the weapon increases its max [[rank]] by '''2''', capping at rank '''40''' after '''5''' polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity. **{{Resource|Elemental Vice}} can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely. **Listed [[Mastery Rank]] requirement is not enforced - the weapon may theoretically be obtained at any mastery rank by acquiring and vanquishing a Sister that has this weapon equipped. {{Advantages|class=Pistol|trigger=Held| *Third highest [[status chance]] of all continuous secondaries, behind the {{Weapon|Embolist}} and {{Weapon|Kuva Nukor}}. *Pinpoint [[accuracy]]. **{{M|Magnum Force}}'s accuracy penalty is minimal on this weapon. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Pistol|trigger=Held| *Limited range of 28 meters, but is extendable to 36 meters with {{M|Ruinous Extension}}. }} {{WeaponComparison|Cycron}} ==Acquisition== {{Transclude|Adversary System/Weapons#Tenet Acquisition (Sister)}} ==Notes== *Upon striking an enemy, the beam chains up to '''2''' enemies within '''7''' meters of the main target. Each chain beam does '''60%''' of the main beam's damage. **Headshotting the original target does not affect the chain damage. **The beam '''will not''' chain to a [[Nullifier Crewman|Nullifier]] through its shield should it connect with a target outside or partially enclosed by it. **The beam can also continue to chain to enemies even if targeting a dead enemy or an enemy who is dead but in a dying animation. **Compared to its Kuva counterpart, the {{Weapon|Kuva Nukor}}, that chains within '''9''' meters at '''50%''' of its main damage, the Tenet Cycron generally deals more damage albeit at a shorter range. But this is not considering the critical stat differences between the two weapons, as while the latter got a far higher critical chance stat (7% against 20%), the former has a far superior critical multiplier stat (5x against 1.8x). **Because the weapon fires a chaining {{D|Heat}} damage, it is functionally similar to the Grineer {{Weapon|Atomos}}. *As the weapon requires charging up to recover its ammunition, players should be mindful of letting the weapon recharge by holding fire - keeping the trigger pressed down will prevent it from fully charging, resulting in an overall DPS drop due to the forced one-second delay in recharging being persistently active. **{{M|Primed Slip Magazine}} can help extend the attack duration by increasing ammo capacity, but care is still needed to ensure the weapon gets to reload first. **The absence of needing ammo pickups does give the Tenet Cycron a slight advantage over the {{Weapon|Kuva Nukor}}, as the former can be always used while the latter can run out of ammo especially in prolonged fights. * [[Punch Through]] will cause the main beam to chain independently from each additional target hit, potentially doubling or tripling the total damage output when fired into a crowd. The chain from the target hit after the Punch Through can deal damage to the first target, and vice versa. {{Transclude|Adversary System#Notes}} {{Transclude|Adversary System/Progenitor}} ==Media== {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|-2_0r8wUW7Y|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|eIy8f_XgG4g|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|33}} *The following weapons can now be found in their corresponding categories in the Arsenal when searching using the tag “Battery”: **Tenet Cycron {{ver|32.0.2}} ;Ammo Changes & Review: When we were reviewing ammo acquisition as a whole for Update 32, we felt weapons with Ammo Regen Rate Overrides, or “Battery,” in particular, needed a place within the ecosystem of change we had established. That said, upon review of feedback, we recognize we were a bit heavy-handed with the changes we made to Battery weapons. We have restored their original values for the time being while we reassess how we can better approach these weapons. We have restored the original values for the following weapons: *Tenet Cycron: **Returned ammo regen rate to 40/s from 20/s {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Secondary Weapons with Ammo Regen Rates Overrides:''' *Tenet Cycron: From 40/s to 20/s {{ver|31.1.1}} *Fixed the Tenet Cycron having force feedback rumble when reloading while using controller. {{ver|31.0.9}} *Fixed lingering muzzle FX on the Tenet Cycron {{ver|30.5}} *Introduced. }} ==See Also== *{{Weapon|Cycron}}, the normal counterpart of this weapon. *{{Weapon|Kuva Nukor}}, a Kuva weapon with a similar chaining beam. *{{Weapon|Atomos}}, a Grineer weapon with a different chaining beam. *{{Weapon|Amprex}}, a Corpus rifle with a different chaining beam. *{{Weapon|Larkspur}}, an [[Archgun]] with a different chaining beam. {{WeaponNav}} [[es:Cycron tenet]] [[uk:Цикрон-догмат]] [[Category:Battery Weapons]] [[Category:Chaining Weapons]]

{{Codex|Itemize and execute with this pair of auto-lock-on, homing-projectile pistols. Shoot from the hip for a more conventional pistol experience. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the pistols when holstered.}}
The '''Tenet Diplos''' are unique [[Tenet]] akimbo pistols with fully automatic fire, an [[Zoom|aimed]] fire mode that locks-on to enemies with burst-fire seeking projectiles, and is able to reload while [[holster]]ed.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon primarily deals {{D|Impact}} damage.
*[[Zoom|Aiming]] activates lock-on mode, targeting up to '''8''' enemies within '''60''' meters on the reticle to burst-fire 2 shots of seeking projectiles per target.
**Lock-on homing targets the enemy's body, making it difficult to achieve headshots unless aiming upward.
**Lock-on projectiles must travel 5 meters before seeking.
**Lock-on burst-fire consumes '''4''' ammo ('''2''' per pistol) per target.
**Lock-on has a ~0.5 second delay after the burst ends before being able to lock-on again (affected by [[fire rate]]).
*Reloads '''10%''' of its magazine per second while [[holster]]ed.
*Innate {{Pol|Madurai}} polarity.
*Adversary Weapon:
**Comes with an additional bonus {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Cold}}, {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Magnetic}}, or {{D|Radiation}} damage, based on the Sister's [[Adversary System/Progenitor|progenitor Warframe]], which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%.
***[[Valence Fusion]] can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%).
**[[Polarization|Polarizing]] the weapon increases its max [[rank]] by '''2''', capping at rank '''40''' after '''5''' polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity.
**{{Resource|Elemental Vice}} can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely.
**Listed [[Mastery Rank]] requirement is not enforced - the weapon may theoretically be obtained at any mastery rank by acquiring and vanquishing a Sister that has this weapon equipped.

{{Advantages|
*Pinpoint [[accuracy]].
*Innate 1 meter [[punch through]].
*Reloads '''8''' rounds per second while [[holster]]ed.

==Notes==
*[[Zoom|Aiming]] toggles lock-on mode.
**Up to a maximum of 8 targets can be locked-on by aiming at enemies within 60 meters, indicated by the circular reticle.
**Locked-on targets are marked by a white diamond that flashes bright at successful home-in.
**If the target moves ? meters away or dies while being aimed at, their lock-ons are removed.
**Full-auto fire can still be used by firing from hip-fire and then zooming in or not aiming over an enemy to not trigger the lock-on.
**Lock-on mode is disabled against targets with invulnerability, such as enemies being corrupted by a [[Void Fissure]], as well as those taking cover inside a [[Nullifier Crewman|Nullifier]] bubble. It is, however, enabled for enemies protected by [[Arbitration Shield Drone|Arbitration Shield Drones]].
**Lock-on does not work with {{WF|Cyte-09}}'s {{A|Seek}}, targets cannot be acquired through walls and homing shots will not pierce walls.
*While holstered, the attaché case's components will rumble and make an audible sound for each ammo reloaded.
**Passive reload stacks with {{M|Eject Magazine}} and the Synth Mod Set ({{M|Synth Deconstruct}}, {{M|Synth Fiber}}, {{M|Synth Reflex}} and {{M|Synth Charge}}).
*Similar to the {{Weapon|Velox}}, these weapons are functionally silent despite having an "Alarming" noise level; they can be fired near enemies without alerting them unless a bullet hits a surface very close to them. However, they will still break {{WF|Ivara}}'s {{A|Prowl}} unless the {{M|Suppress}} mod is equipped.
{{Transclude|Adversary System#Notes}}
{{Transclude|Adversary System/Progenitor}}

== Known Bugs ==
* {{M|Galvanized Shot}} is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits from lock-on mode.

==Tips==
*The Diplos has noticeable recoil, so it is recommended to fire the guns at short bursts or mitigate the recoil with {{M|Steady Hands}}.
*If not using lock-on mode, hip-firing and then ADS will grant the bonuses of aiming without enabling the lock-on mechanic.
*When using lock-on mode, wait until the lock-on indicator flashes before pulling the trigger to ensure that the gun will not go full auto mode. This is particularly useful when in the middle of an encounter with too much visual noise, such as explosions from an allied player's weapons or being struck by a {{D|Magnetic}} proc.
*The Diplos cannot lock in on [[Arbitration Shield Drone]]s, making the guns ineffective at disposing them. Additionally, the lock-on mode is enabled against enemies protected by the drone, wasting shots on invulnerable targets.
*You can start hip firing then ADS to keep the Diplos full-auto to make use of mods like [[Galvanized Crosshairs]] easier.

==Trivia==
*While holstered and while reloading, the weapon folds up into an attaché case.
*The weapon's name means "twofold", referring to how the weapon folds when (un)sheathed.
*Tenet Diplos lacks the "Dual" naming scheme seen with other Corpus akimbo weapons (e.g. {{Weapon|Dual Cestra}}).

==Bugs==
*Aiming down sights away from an enemy and using an autoclicker or mousewheel to fire the weapon causes it to fire as fast as the inputs register. This has no practical application as moving the reticle over an enemy immediately causes the lock-on function to activate.
*The Diplos used to be able to lock in on [[Arbitration Shield Drone]]s, making the guns effective at disposing them. Additionally, the lock-on mode was disabled against enemies protected by the drone, preventing the player from wasting shots on invulnerable targets. This behavior has now been reversed. As it is an undocumented change, it is likely a bug.

The '''Tenet Ferrox''' is the [[Tenet]] variant of the {{Weapon|Ferrox}}, with improvements to its [[critical chance]], [[critical multiplier]], [[status chance]], [[fire rate]], and [[magazine size]], slightly larger explosion radius, has innate [[Punch Through]] , and max radial [[damage falloff]]. ==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage on its primary fire and {{D|Impact}} damage on its alt-fire.
*Primary Fire charges and shoots thin beams.
**Holding the fire button after shooting will immediately charge up the next shot.
***After reloading, trigger must be released and pressed again to begin firing, however. 
**Beams are [[hitscan]] and do not have [[Projectile Speed|projectile travel time]], despite the animation.
**Shots explode in a '''4''' meter radius after reaching maximum punch through distance.
***Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
***Can benefit from {{M|Cautious Shot}}.
**Vaporizes enemies on kill, making it good for [[stealth]] when silenced.
*[[Alternate Fire]] throws the Ferrox, creating a field where it lands that deals {{D|Electricity}} damage every '''2''' seconds and continuously pulls enemies within '''10''' meters toward itself. The field lasts for '''30''' seconds.
**Throwing the spear consumes no ammo. Afterwards, a reload cycle must complete before it can fire or be thrown again. Any existing terrain-embedded spears are removed. Those embedded in a unit's body are not.
**The spear is an arcing projectile that can land and embed in the terrain or a unit.
**[[Multishot]] has no effect on the number of spears thrown.
**[[Fire Rate]] affects the damage frequency, but not the pull speed.
**({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}){{M|Firestorm}} has no effect on pull range.
**The field has a flat, unmoddable 50% status chance. It cannot deal critical hits nor headshots and is not affected by multishot. The damage frequency is affected by fire rate. It does not snapshot anything.
*Reloads '''33%''' of the magazine per second while deployed or [[holster]]ed.
*Adversary Weapon:
**Comes with an additional bonus {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Cold}}, {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Magnetic}}, or {{D|Radiation}} damage, which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%.
***[[Valence Fusion]] can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%).
**[[Polarization|Polarizing]] the weapon increases its max [[rank]] by '''2''', capping at rank '''40''' after '''5''' polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity.
**{{Resource|Elemental Vice}} can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely.
**Unlike Tenet weapons directly acquired from Sisters, the listed [[Mastery Rank]] requirement '''is''' enforced.

==Tips==
